_doc: Aged 3.1.2 project ids that are knowingly NOT yet covered by mods-manifest.json. An entry may only stay here while the manifest has no realized result for it: inmis and inmisaddon were removed in 0.1.57 because both carry realized_by=inmis and both ship in the pack. A manifest action alone (keep/rebuild/port with an empty realized_by) is a PLAN, not a shipment, and does not earn a removal. Every entry is debt: W2 adoptions (official 26.2 build exists), W4 port-queue items, or unplanned gaps. aged_parity_diff.py fails on any Aged mod pid that is neither keyed in the manifest nor listed here, so this file is the explicit, machine-checked acknowledgement of missing parity.
